# Test pe cache commands - verifiable shared caching

# Basic cache operations
pe cache status
stdout 'Cache Status:'
stdout 'Size: 0 MB'
stdout 'Entries: 0'
stdout 'Hit rate: N/A'

# Run with caching
pe run "What is 2+2?" --cache
stdout '4'
pe cache status
stdout 'Entries: 1'

# Cache hit
pe run "What is 2+2?" --cache
stdout '4'
stdout '(cached)'
pe cache status
stdout 'Hit rate: 50%'

# List cache entries
pe cache list
stdout 'Cache entries:'
stdout 'Hash.*Model.*Size.*Age'
stdout 'sha256:.*gpt-4.*150B.*<1m'

# Inspect cache entry
pe cache inspect sha256:abc123
stdout 'Cache Entry Details:'
stdout 'Prompt hash: sha256:abc123'
stdout 'Response hash: sha256:def456'
stdout 'Model: gpt-4'
stdout 'Timestamp:'
stdout 'Verification: VALID'

# Import verified cache
pe cache import team-cache.bundle --verify
stdout 'Importing cache bundle'
stdout 'Verifying signatures'
stdout '✓ Signature valid: alice@team.com'
stdout '✓ Witness valid: bob@team.com'
stdout 'Imported 50 entries'

# Export cache with signing
pe cache export --sign --output my-cache.bundle
stdout 'Exporting cache'
stdout 'Signing with key: user@example.com'
stdout 'Exported 51 entries'
exists my-cache.bundle

# Verify cache integrity
pe cache verify
stdout 'Verifying cache integrity'
stdout '✓ All entries valid'
stdout '✓ No tampering detected'

# Deep verification with witnesses
pe cache verify --deep
stdout 'Deep verification'
stdout 'Checking witness signatures'
stdout 'Witness 1: bob@team.com ✓'
stdout 'Witness 2: cache.pe.dev ✓'
stdout 'Certificate chain: VALID'

# Clear cache
pe cache clear
stdout 'Clear cache? (y/N)'
stdin 'y'
stdout 'Cache cleared'
pe cache status
stdout 'Entries: 0'

# Cache with TTL
pe run "Current time?" --cache --ttl 60s
stdout 'The current time is'
sleep 61s
pe run "Current time?" --cache --ttl 60s
stdout 'The current time is'
! stdout '(cached)'

# Selective cache clear
pe cache clear --older-than 24h
stdout 'Cleared 5 entries older than 24h'

# Cache statistics
pe cache stats
stdout 'Cache Statistics:'
stdout 'Total requests: 100'
stdout 'Cache hits: 45'
stdout 'Cache misses: 55'
stdout 'Hit rate: 45%'
stdout 'Space saved: $12.30'
stdout 'Time saved: 4m 32s'

# Privacy-preserving cache
pe run "Sensitive query" --cache --private
stdout 'Response'
pe cache list
stdout 'sha256:.*<private>.*<private>'

-- team-cache.bundle --
{
  "version": "1.0",
  "entries": [...],
  "signatures": {
    "alice@team.com": "sig:...",
    "bob@team.com": "sig:..."
  },
  "witnesses": [
    {"id": "cache.pe.dev", "timestamp": "...", "sig": "..."}
  ]
}
